title: viva-marketplace modules registry
description: The hand-edited registry of ecosystem repos (viva_marketplace/modules.json). Every PR touching it is validated against this schema by scripts/validate_modules.py. Name uniqueness is enforced separately (JSON Schema can't express cross-item uniqueness by a single key).

ref.description: Branch/tag to clone, or a full 40-hex commit SHA for a reproducibility-attested pin (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
